relevance_note: Case report of a family with LAMP2 variants: 'A genetic test revealed a hemizygous mutation in the LAMP2 gene (LAMP2: c.963G > A' in the proband, with five affected relatives.
method_note: Single-family case report (one pedigree, no family label; pedigree IDs used in headings: Pt 1 = III4, Pt 2 = II4, Pt 3 = II2, Pt 4 = II6, Pt 5 = III5; Pt 6 has no pedigree ID because the heading 'Family member 5' runs into the text). Labels 'Pt n' are the paper's most frequent form. II3 (father of Pt 1) is included as a tested relative: Figure 2 legend shows his gene sequence, but the text never states his result, so he has no variant row and no features. Built with a short Python script from manual reading; no table was transcribed by script. Variant: only Pt 1 has a printed description (c.963G > A, hemizygous). Pt 5's text says 'the mutation of LAMP2 as in Pt 1', so c.963G > A is recorded for him; Pt 2, Pt 3, Pt 4 and Pt 6 are said to carry a 'similar' mutation as in Pt 1, which does not state identity, so their variant strings are 'not reported' and inheritance is 'not reported' for Pt 1, Pt 5 and Pt 6 (mother described as carrying a 'similar' mutation). Ages 'aged 16/38/40/8/2 years' are ages at presentation or in the narrative with unclear timing relative to follow-up (e.g. Pt 2 followed 2003-2021), so they are not recorded as onset or last evaluation; Pt 6 onset taken from the Discussion ('the onset age was just 2 years'). Country not recorded: only the hospital location (Anhui, China) is given. Group statements used: 'the motor function and muscle strength of the six patents were normal' (muscle weakness excluded for all six); 'All the males showed typical clinical manifestations such as LVH' (LVH for Pt 5 and Pt 6). 'Proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopathy)' left not reported for Pt 1 and Pt 5 because the authors say their raised creatine kinase indicates 'the possible damage of skeletal muscles' despite normal strength. Unnamed group statements not assigned: 'one developed Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome' (among males), 'two developed heart failure', 'the cardiac MRI of the three patients ... identified delayed enhancement', '5 patients of 6 evinced significant ECG disorders'. Pt 4 'echocardiography found no anomaly' recorded as written (excludes nothing more specific). Pt 2 funduscopy ('no hypopigmentation') not used to exclude the composite retinopathy/retinal dystrophy item. Pt 1 AVRT and Pt 2 paroxysmal AF counted as supraventricular tachycardia; Pt 2's AVRT is with a concealed accessory pathway, so pre-excitation left not reported. Pt 1 learning item based on self-reported 'low performance in primary school (not verified by professional tests)'. Pt 2's Table 1 (echo indexes by date) is used only for regurgitation and pulmonary hypertension notes. No contradictions found.
